authorization: 用户授权自主研究；root已认可源码/四scope并授权完成前瞻冻结后执行EX071固定统计与独立核验
question: EX066/067的late_weakness持有池线索是否在真实成交持仓与已知持仓年龄/盈亏控制后仍有继续持有信息，尤其2023？
selection_history: 已见EX066/067/068/069/070开发池结论；复用已发现的单一固定组件，结果为条件线索确认而非封存验证，置信区间未纠正研究选择偏差

feature_method.component: late_weakness=-EX061 late_recovery=-log(C8/C6); positive return and negative risk hypotheses fixed
feature_method.state_time: account_daily.date=T quantity is post T fills, marked with T close, known at T17; account_daily.signal_date is prior execution-plan signal and must not align T features
feature_method.signal_before: decision.target_position keyed by valid_session=T; previous signal already formed before T
feature_method.signal_after: decision.target_position keyed by signal_date=T; intended next-session target, not current holdings

known_controls.holding_age: number of actual execution sessions since first BUY in current position including entry day; entry day=1
known_controls.entry_mark_pnl: Close[T]/remaining known cost-weighted gross entry price-1; BUY fees excluded; only fills on/before T used
known_controls.known_falling: original known momentum20[T]<0, not realized annual return

labels.continue_open_h: (1-f)*Open[T+1+h]/((1-f)*Open[T+1])-1 = futureOpen/nextOpen-1; hold versus sell next open, same quantity/sell fee, no new BUY fee
labels.risk_open_h: max(0,1-min(Open/Close at T+1..T+h and final Open[T+1+h])/Open[T+1]); fixed daily observations, excludes initial Tclose->nextOpen gap
labels.marked_close_net_h: (1-f)*Open[T+1+h]/Close[T]-1; remaining holding liquidation from Tclose mark, exactly one future SELL fee and no sunk BUY fee
labels.risk_close_h: max(0,1-same_future_observed_min/Close[T]); includes initial next-open movement; price risk not fee-adjusted
labels.immediate_close_net: (1-f)*Open[T+1]/Close[T]-1; companion showing next-open liquidation and unavoidable first overnight
labels.maturity: all horizon labels mature at final Open[T+1+h]; missing tails remain missing, no extension
labels.accounting_companions_only: close-mark labels, risk_close, immediate liquidation and increment_mark retained but no additional model/IC searches

feature_method.risk_limit: OPEN/CLOSE observation downside omits intraday extremes and is not actual path or account maximum drawdown; High/Low deliberately unused
feature_method.counterfactual: fixed T quantity hypothetically retained across future old strategy exits; not old realized account return and not a proposed execution rule
feature_method.strongest_counterargument: next-open continuation return is affine-equivalent to old fee-adjusted fresh-entry label; fee removal cannot create predictive ordering; novelty is actual-held pool and causal holding controls
feature_method.selection: retain every requested T row; flat age/PnL remain NaN, not zero; future label or future trade exit cannot select population

label_contract.return_h: Open[T+1+h]/Open[T+1]-1; same future/current SELL fee cancels, no new BUY fee
label_contract.downside_h: max(0,1-min(Open/Close T+1..T+h and finalOpen[T+1+h])/Open[T+1]); fixed daily observation downside, not path/account DD
label_contract.negative_gap_next: Initial Tclose-to-nextOpen gap retained for accounting attribution only; both T+1 decision alternatives share it
label_contract.maturity_columns: label_end_<label>; first test signal strictly after train label maturity

statistics.correlation: Spearman average ties; partial rank IC uses OLS residuals with intercept and all twenty-two controls, explicitly excluding component linear opposite late_recovery, partial residual DF n-rank(design)>=10 required; otherwise unavailable, recording design_rank/residual_df; residual norm <=1e-10 of original centered-rank norm is explained/unavailable
statistics.non_overlap: h+1 phases fixed by original full signal index positions before finite/opportunity filtering

bootstrap.sampling: overlapping full-time-axis blocks, uniform starts, truncate to original length; filter opportunity after sampling
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5% linear quantiles; at least 400 valid replicates
bootstrap.scope: all four predeclared scopes; descriptive, no search-selection correction

walk_forward.train: 2020 <= signal year < test year AND label_end_label < first actual test-year signaldate
walk_forward.groups: train feature Q25/Q75 linear; test low <= Q25, high >= Q75; original label means
walk_forward.ridge: rank features via train empirical CDF midpoint ties; original target; intercept unpenalized; alpha=10
walk_forward.common_model_rows: all 23 feature columns finite, target finite, training target mature; identical model rows
walk_forward.baseline: training target mean on identical training rows; compare test MSE and Spearman IC

statistics.scope: actual_held, declining_actual_held, actual_signal_continue, actual_signal_exit; no flat zero imputation; no profitable-row selection
limitations: Already-seen development pool; chronological pseudo-out-of-sample, not sealed independent validation.
No hyperparameter search; all labels, years, phases, components and failures retained.
Future labels never enter feature columns, ECDF, thresholds, or fitting before maturity.
Intervals are descriptive diagnostics and do not correct development-pool selection bias.

hypothesis_signs.late_weakness: positive return4, negative downside4; h8 auxiliary same direction; never reverse on result

control_exclusion: 原20去late_recovery，因其是组件的精确线性反向；按代数预先排除，不按表现挑选；其余19固定控制加holding_age/entry_mark_pnl/known_falling，共22

partial_df: n-rank(intercept+rankcontrols)>=10且n>=20；否则null及reason/rank/df；常数known_falling/同池约束按实际rank计算；不放低DF或合并薄scope
